caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical object with a handle, mounted atop a baluster-shaped stand, which rises from the center of a shallow, circular dish. The handle is attached at the midpoint of the main vertical support, curving outward and upward. The entire composition is rendered in shades of grey and black on a beige background, giving the objects a metallic or matte finish. A rectangular inset in the upper left corner shows a scaled-down, diagrammatic version of the object with measurements provided. The primary illustration dominates the center of the page, enclosed in a rectangle, with the artist's signature "M. Mangiacotti" at the lower right corner within the frame. The lighting and shading suggest a three-dimensional form, highlighting the contours and reflective surfaces of the objects.
title: Lamp
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
